notes: Auth/browser-init config ONLY. Updated 2026-07-26: browser.headless flipped false -> true — headless is now the platform-wide default for both browser mechanisms (the Playwright MCP server carries a matching --headless in .mcp.json). Headed is an explicit per-call opt-in: BrowserDriver.authenticate({ headless: false }). Updated 2026-07-27: added browser.headlessByStage — a per-stage display-mode override consulted ahead of the global headless default. manual_execution:false makes Stage 4 (Manual Execution) headed as its NORMAL behaviour, not an opt-in, because that stage exists for a human to watch each interaction happen live (.claude/skills/manual-execution-skill/SKILL.md 11.1); callers select it by passing stage:'manual_execution'. Precedence: explicit headless argument > headlessByStage[stage] > headless. Updated 2026-07-25 (Manual Execution Agent, Agency module run): defaultBaseUrl reverted from .80 back to .70 — live login (credentials.json's current STG baseUrl) now redirects to http://192.168.1.70/dashboard, not .80. The .80 value set 2026-07-13 per FINDING-001 no longer matches reality; relative-path navigate() calls were failing (redirected to /auth/login) because they resolved against the wrong origin's cookie jar. Screen/component locators do NOT belong here — see platform_core_data/browser/screens/ and /components/.
